inspector.pipeline: full agent orchestration over recorded fixtures (vision, research, NHTSA, vPIC, sweep) — offline, frozen clock

cases.name: clean car, full pipeline
cases.description: An excellent-condition M3 with a matching federal decode: verdict pass, nothing invented, every stage accounted for.

checks.desc: the report is the final event of a successful run
clean car earns a pass verdict
every stage announces begin before its status lands (stage rail contract)
model and fetch calls stream trace spans with timings
the subject listing never appears in its own comp set
the federal decode fills model/body/plant and finds no mismatch
the VIN section never prints a history verdict — it links the services that do check

cases.name: rust changes the research path
cases.description: The same car with rust in the photos must produce a different, rust-driven research plan, and cited findings must flow into the money math.

checks.desc: two cars with different photos produce different research paths
every research topic states the reason it was chosen
high-severity rust pulls the verdict to caution
cited repair costs surface in the report for the money panel

cases.name: uncited claims do not survive
cases.description: The research agent returns four findings: two cited, one with no source, one with a garbage URL. Only the cited two may exist afterward.

checks.desc: findings without a valid http(s) source are discarded during validation
the cited critical finding survives and becomes a red flag

cases.name: photo anchors are validated
cases.description: Vision returns anchors pointing at photos 7 and -1 of a 3-photo set. The finding must survive with no anchors rather than being assigned one.

checks.desc: out-of-range anchors are dropped, the finding keeps none
the de-anchored finding still reaches the report

cases.name: federal identity mismatch forces avoid
cases.description: vPIC decodes the VIN as a Honda Civic while the listing claims a BMW M3 — the run must flag it with federal wording and refuse to pass the car.

checks.desc: the mismatch cites the federal database
an identity mismatch is an automatic avoid

cases.name: missing key refuses honestly
cases.description: No vision caller and no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: the inspection must refuse with a fatal, never mock an analysis.

checks.desc: no key means an honest fatal, not a mocked inspection
the vision stage reports its failure before the fatal

cases.name: stage isolation under dead upstreams
cases.description: NHTSA is down and no comps cover the car: both stages must degrade visibly while the report still lands with a computed verdict.

checks.desc: NHTSA failure yields a named degraded status, not a crash
no comps means a visibly degraded market stage, not a guess
independent failures never kill the run
the report carries the degraded stages for the UI to show

cases.name: malformed vision output is fatal, not papered over
cases.description: The vision model returns garbage. The run must fail validation loudly instead of inventing an analysis.

checks.desc: unparseable vision output ends the run with a validation error

cases.name: VIN provenance is citation-gated
cases.description: The sweep returns the subject listing, a real sighting, and an uncited one. Only the real sighting may survive, with its host derived.

checks.desc: uncited sightings are discarded; the subject listing is excluded
date and price ride along verbatim

cases.name: determinism under a frozen clock
cases.description: The same fixtures and a frozen clock must produce byte-identical reports across two runs — the agent has no hidden nondeterminism.

checks.desc: two runs over identical fixtures produce identical reports
generatedAt comes from the injected clock

salvage.pipeline: recorded live traces (triage + cited research) replayed through the current money model, graded per check

cases.name: huracan-dead-title
cases.description: Non-repairable title with cited wreck prices and thin part-out citations. hand-converted 2026-08-17 from the recorded freeform findings into typed comps, each as its source stated it.

checks.desc: the verdict is bid or no bid
a damage program carries at most one structural line
every cost line carries a basis and an evidence chip
every comp behind the exit has a positive price and an http(s) source
the ceiling is the highest $500 step whose all-in stays at or under discipline
a zero ceiling names its killers and its unlocks
a dealbreaker forces no bid regardless of the money
the exit is a band: low ≤ typical ≤ high, high under 2.6× low (a 1.4/0.7 comp spread times the 0.65/0.5 discount band)
a derived exit sits below the clean money it derives from
the wreck market is a plausible band: no pocket change, high under 4× low
no wreck comp used sits at clean money
stress ≤ ceiling ≤ break-even
the hidden-damage contingency never sits below the tier floor
a no-bid verdict never carries "Bid to" copy
the exit basis names its hosts or confesses a derivation
a dead rebuild lane states its veto in the summary
verdict is walk
a dealbreaker is stated
the verdict does not flip on the wreck market
